name: The Tome of Nobility
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Hello, adventurer. I see your dedication remains strong, as does your faith.

I think it is time you spoke with Duthorian Rall in Stormwind. There are some more lessons for you to learn, and I feel you are prepared.

Seek him out in the Cathedral of Light, and adventurer, take these lessons seriously. You've attained your status through humility and hard work, do not disappoint us by becoming arrogant.

Be well.
narrative.objectives: Speak to Duthorian Rall in Stormwind.
